title: Physicists directly observe quantum gravity effects on ultracold atoms
summary: Researchers directly observed a quantum effect of gravity predicted by Einstein using ultracold atoms split between a held position and free fall.

title: 66-Million-Year-Old Feather in Dinosaur Feces Hints Why Birds Survived Asteroid Impact
summary: A feather fossilized in 66-million-year-old dinosaur excrement suggests advanced insulating plumage may have enabled modern birds' ancestors to survive the asteroid extinction event.
updatesTitle: Fossilized Bird Feather in Dinosaur Coprolite Sheds Light on Avian Survival of Mass Extinction

takeaways: First demonstration of cardiac regeneration in human heart tissue, not just mice

title: August Records as Earth's Hottest Month as El Niño Strengthens
summary: Global temperatures reached record highs in August as climate scientists warn of accelerating warming patterns coinciding with a strengthening El Niño event.

title: Quantum computing breakthrough: 1,000x faster operations reduce error rates
summary: Researchers demonstrate quantum operations 1,000 times faster, significantly reducing computational errors from external disturbances.

title: Comprehensive supernova catalog challenges prevailing dark energy theory
summary: A global team analyzing the most complete catalog of white dwarf supernovae has uncovered new evidence about dark energy and cosmic expansion.

title: Scientists discover 3D DNA organization disruption in Alzheimer's disease

The finding, published in Science, opens new avenues for understanding disease mechanisms beyond amyloid-beta plaq
takeaways: 3D genome folding disrupted in Alzheimer's-affected brain cells

Research from Carnegie Mellon, University of Pittsburgh, and University of Washington

title: NASA's next major observatory to search for oceans on distant exoplanets
summary: A future NASA observatory could definitively detect liquid oceans on exoplanets within habitable zones, advancing the search for extraterrestrial life.

title: Global warming breaks 400-year climate coupling between Indian and Pacific oceans
summary: Scientists at Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution found that a 400-year climate coupling between the Indian and Pacific oceans is breaking down due to human-caused warming. The disruption is described as exceptional and far more unusual than temporary disruptions caused by past volcanic eruptions.
takeaways: Climate coupling maintained for past 400 years now disrupted since 1980s
Reconstructed using corals, tree rings, stalagmites, and climate models back to early 1600s
Volcanic eruptions 1810–1850 temporarily weakened connection; current warming effect unprecedented
Published in Nature Communications
Paleoclimate evidence resolved whether recent changes represent unusual shift or natural cycle

summary: Semaglutide, the active ingredient in Ozempic and Wegovy, extended lifespan by nearly 100 days in older mice while improving memory, muscle function, and reducing aging markers, according to an NIH-funded UC Berkeley study. takeaways: Median lifespan extended by nearly 100 days in treated mice

title: Base editing in human embryos achieves comprehensive gene edits but causes unpredictable changes
summary: Columbia University researchers found that base editing can modify genes in all cells of human embryos but produces unpredictable genetic changes that pose significant risks.

title: Physicists Convert Classical Light into Quantum Information Processing System
summary: Researchers have developed a method to transform classical light into a quantum system capable of information processing, potentially overcoming quantum fragility challenges.

title: Diamond's Melting Point Corrected by Over 1,000 Degrees via Laser Measurement
summary: New laser-based measurements reveal diamond's melting point is more than 1,000 degrees higher than previously thought, with implications for fusion and planetary science.

title: UCLA develops cancer-fighting T cells from cord blood for solid tumors

takeaways: AlloESO-T cells successfully controlled ovarian cancer and melanoma in mice with single dose

title: Future extreme weather events may exceed historical precedent, research warns
summary: Researchers at King's College London warn that historical storm and heat wave records may underestimate the severity and impact of future climate disasters.

summary: Researchers discovered that blue light can break a long-standing chemistry rule to create three-dimensional drug compounds, departing from traditional flat aromatic ring structures.

title: Atlantic current collapse could trigger severe global food production decline
summary: A new study forecasts dire impacts on global agriculture if key Atlantic Ocean currents weaken or collapse.

title: First Antarctic-Wide Map of Grounded Icebergs Reveals 'Picket Fence Effect' Stabilizing Sea Ice
summary: Researchers used artificial intelligence to create the first high-resolution continent-wide map of grounded icebergs in Antarctica, revealing how they stabilize sea ice through a 'picket fence effect.'

title: Climate warming expands geographic range of infectious diseases

summary: Cornell researchers used artificial intelligence to identify a previously unknown cellular control mechanism regulating protein movement, a process disrupted in cancer development.

title: DNA mystery solved: researchers capture DNA molecules zipping together for first time

title: Chandra discovers hypersoft X-ray sources solving astrophysical puzzles

title: Contiguous U.S. Records Hottest Summer on Record Amid Climate Change
summary: The contiguous United States experienced its hottest summer on record, prompting scientists to sound alarm bells about accelerating climate impacts.

summary: OpenAI claims to have made progress on the unsolved Navier-Stokes equations worth a $1 million prize, but mathematicians question how the breakthrough was achieved so quickly.

summary: Scientists found that combinations of toxin-blocking proteins naturally present in rattlesnake blood are about 10 times more effective than current commercial antivenoms.

summary: A large Swedish study of nearly 15,000 people with bipolar disorder found that semaglutide use (Ozempic, Wegovy) was associated with a 21% lower risk of psychiatric hospitalization.

summary: NASA's Hubble and James Webb Space Telescopes combined to study trans-Neptunian objects and discovered unexpected scarcity of smaller bodies, revealing preserved formation history.

title: Scientists discover immune 'off switch' that stops inflammation

Drug increased epoxy-oxylipin levels and sharply reduced intermediate monocytes in blood and tissue
Findings suggest therapeutic targets for arthritis, heart disease, and diabetes

summary: Machine learning analysis of 400,000 Reddit posts identified unexpected side effects reported by users of GLP-1 drugs including menstrual changes, hot flashes, and chills. Two symptom categories flagged for investigation: reproductive changes and body temperature problems
Study does not establish causation but identifies signals worth examining
University of Pennsylvania research spanning five years of Reddit data

summary: Ancient rocks from Western Australia's Pilbara Craton, over 3 billion years old, reveal that water was reaching Earth's mantle and fueling volcanic activity long before modern plate tectonics developed. Scientists propose "dripduction"—a process where water-rich crustal sections sagged into the hott
